signedOut.title: Sign in to view orders
signedOut.description: Orders belong to your buyer account. Sign in to continue.

checkout.title: Confirm order
checkout.description: Enter delivery details and submit. Unpaid orders expire after 30 minutes.

cartChanged.title: Your selected cart items changed
cartChanged.description: Review the updated items, quantities, and availability. Unavailable items are excluded. Confirm the updated selection before placing your order.

direct.invalidDescription: Return to the product page and choose an available option.
direct.unavailableDescription: The option is disabled or no longer has enough stock. Choose another option on the product page.

directAttempt.title: An unfinished purchase attempt was found
directAttempt.description: Your previous request may have created an order. Check your orders or retry with the same delivery details.
directAttempt.mismatch: The delivery details differ from the previous attempt. Restore the previous details to retry, or explicitly start a new purchase.
directAttempt.startNew: Start a new purchase with these details

cartAttempt.title: An unfinished cart checkout was found
cartAttempt.description: Your previous request may have created an order. Check your orders, or retry with the same items and delivery details.
cartAttempt.mismatch: The cart items or delivery details differ from the previous attempt. Restore the previous details to retry, or start a new checkout with the current details.
cartAttempt.startNew: Start a new checkout with these details

summary.title: Order items
summary.notice: The displayed item prices are used for the order snapshot. Current stock availability is checked at submission.
summary.directNotice: The latest price and available stock are checked when you submit. The final amount is shown on the order page.

empty.title: No items to check out
empty.description: Return to the cart and select available items.

errors.receiverNameLength: Recipient name must be 50 characters or fewer
errors.receiverPhoneLength: Phone number must be 32 characters or fewer
errors.shippingAddressLength: Shipping address must be 1000 characters or fewer

list.title: My orders
list.description: Review submitted orders and their current status.

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.description: Orders submitted from the cart will appear here.

cancel.title: Cancel this order?
cancel.description: The frozen stock for order #{{id}} will be released. The submitted order cannot be restored.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalidCheckout: Check the checkout details and try again.
errors.checkoutConflict: The cart or product details changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.cannotCancel: This order cannot be cancelled. Refresh for the latest status.
errors.server: The server cannot process the request right now. Try again later.
errors.notFound: The order does not exist or belongs to another account.
